Since 21 October: 'jullie' for 'u' throughout Erik's script; the programme in one state then Else; the courses named as the printed menu; CO2 impact one click; a 2025 bar on CO2 behaald; Recyclage off; the opening wall at 100 pieces; the ending a blank wall.

The speaker's sheets name who reads every line, Karim Weiss's in a filled tag.

Since 27 October: the 730 wall on black, the courses as 1e to 5e gang, the quotes broken as even blocks, the opening wall at 91 straight pieces counted to 100, the name tags toward the seam, the life cycle in three clicks with Erik's lines shortened, the certificate an A4 sheet, the music at -18.5 dB.
